WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    o.ordertune,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM riskandmargin r
  INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM type_counts
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.count,
    (tc.count - ac.avg_count) as excess
  FROM type_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN average_count ac
  WHERE tc.count > ac.avg_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(aa.count) as avg_count,
  AVG(aa.excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average aa
